a.text: Fresh fruit! Sweetest in Ban Suan! Whatever Ken says is a lie.

good.text: Everything! But the mangosteen... oh, the mangosteen.

a.text: For Somchai? Finally! I've been saving the best for him.

b.text: Here — one crate of the freshest vegetables in Ban Suan. Don't drop it!

a.text: There's my favourite customer! Everyone's eating at Somchai's again thanks to you.

b.text: Even Ken admitted it was a good idea. Ken! Admitting something!
